decision: Do not expand precision-only training unless both K values at length2048 show absolute mean paired NLL change above0.01 with context-bootstrap95CI excluding0. Exploratory selection changes alone do not count as improved quality.
scope: Frozen dense-pretrained Pythia70m with all six attention layers replaced for evaluation. Same weights, QKV dtype, blocks, topk and attention kernel between pooling variants. A FP32 pool is rounded back to BF16 before the unchanged router. This is not native sparse training, a new algorithm, long-context beyond2048, or a standard published WikiText perplexity protocol. Input windows are reused public test-corpus material, not pretraining-decontaminated new data.
protocol_revision_reason: Inserted EOS per paragraph dominated dense NLL. Replace with newline-joined raw text and no synthetic special token insertion; preserve the excluded pilot and original thresholds.
